description: This file contains the implementation of a test adapter for Zend HTTP client. The class 'Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Test' provides methods to simulate HTTP requests and responses for testing purposes, without performing real network operations. It includes functions to set responses, simulate failures, and manage configuration.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Test
classes.description: A testing adapter implementing Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Interface to simulate HTTP requests and responses for testing Zend HTTP client components.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the test adapter. Currently does nothing but initializes the object.

methods.name: setNextRequestWillFail
methods.description: Sets a flag indicating whether the next request should fail with an exception.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration options for the adapter. Accepts an array or Zend_Config object.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Simulates connecting to a remote server. Can throw an exception if configured to fail.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Prepares an HTTP request string based on input parameters, mimicking sending a request.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Returns the next response from the internal response buffer, simulating reading a response.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the response(s) that will be returned on subsequent read() calls.

methods.name: addResponse
methods.description: Adds additional response(s) to the response buffer.

methods.name: setResponseIndex
methods.description: Sets which response in the buffer will be returned on the next read().
